subject: Upper limit to number of plotly plots in a dashboard

messages.author: 390f05dadd1c7553
messages.subject: Upper limit to number of plotly plots in a dashboard
parts:
I would like to create a dashboard which has about 8 plotly plots. Currently, I am creating with multiple calls to renderPlotly ...

fluidRow(
    column(4,plotlyOutput("plotly",width="100%")),
    column(4,plotlyOutput("plotly2",width="100%")),
    column(4,plotlyOutput("plotly3",width="100%"))
  ), 
  fluidRow(
    column(4,plotlyOutput("plotly4",width="100%")),
    column(4,plotlyOutput("plotly5",width="100%")),
    column(4,plotOutput("plotly6",width="100%"))
  )

Where each calls something like ...

  output$plotly <- renderPlotly({
    ua_views_by_area(input$dates[1],input$dates[2],input$ua_space)
  })

  output$plotly2 <- renderPlotly({
    ua_vols_time_series(input$dates[1],input$dates[2],input$ua_space)
  })

etc ...

However, I only seem to be able to create 6 plots, Ideally I would like more.

Is there a limitation on the maximum number of plotly plots please?

Also, is the above the best way to achieve this, should I be doing this another way?

thanks!
